title: 117 Gulf Shore Drive - West | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Beach Blue Properties, LLC
meta_description: Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. #117 West at Gulf Trace, Grayton Beach brought to you by Beach Blue Properties."WITHOUT A TRACE - WEST"...
description_expanded: Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. #117 West at Gulf Trace, Grayton Beach brought to you by Beach Blue Properties. "WITHOUT A TRACE - WEST" sleeps 13 guests, Newly remodeled. *117 Gulf Shore Drive W. and 117 Gulf Shore Drive E. may be rented together for a total of 10 bedrooms and 10 bathrooms. Please note this property is available for families and adults over the age of 25. Please do not inquire for a student spring break group. *The HOA does not allow golf carts in Gulf Trace. Sparkling blue beaches…. sugar white sand…. blissful sunny days. It all awaits you at 117 Gulf Shore Drive - West. This vacation home is built right on the sand in the residential enclave of Gulf Trace - just off 30A in Grayton Beach. With 2900 square feet, our home offers five bedrooms, five bathrooms, and is roomy enough to comfortably accommodate up to thirteen guests. No need to rush to get to the beach – you are already there! Take time to sit on the balcony and enjoy watching the kids play in the sand. With 80 feet of beach frontage, there is no better beach location. So come prepared to build a sand castle and bask in the sun! Designed with family enjoyment in mind, our main level offers an open concept living and kitchen area. New LVP flooring and new furnishings invite you to relax and enjoy your beach experience. The kitchen features granite countertops and stainless appliances, and is fully stocked with everything needed to prepare meals for your stay. For the chef in the group, there is a BBQ grill on the balcony. The living area offers plenty of comfortable seating for everyone to enjoy movie entertainment on the large flat panel HDTV television. Complimentary WIFI is provided. Each of the five bedroom suites offers a private, full bathroom. There is beachfront balcony access from two of the bedrooms. For your convenience, a full laundry room is located on the main level. 1st FL: Kitchen, Living room, Dining room, Balcony, Queen bedroom with full bathroom, Laundry room 2nd FL: King bedroom with full bathroom and balcony, King bedroom with full bathroom and balcony, 1 Queen bedroom with full bathroom, Kids room with twin over twin bunk, twin over full bunk, and full bathroom. Dining out is a delight in Grayton Beach! Great restaurants abound from casual to elegant in the old village of Grayton Beach itself or nearby in Seaside or Blue Mountain Beach. In fact, all of the picturesque villages of Scenic 30A are just minutes away offering delightful diversions for sensational shopping at unique boutiques, free live musical entertainment and special seasonal festivities. The location is unsurpassed, and the accommodations are perfect ~ make some beach memories at 117 Gulf Shore Drive in Grayton Beach! All vehicles parked at a residence must fit within the boundaries of the driveway (can fit 3 cars) RV's and camper trailers are not allowed. Illegally parked vehicles will be towed at guest's expense. *Golf Cart rentals are not allowed per neighborhood association. CANCELLATION: Reservations that are cancelled more than 30 days prior to the arrival date receive a full refund. Reservations cancelled 14-29 days prior to arrival receive a refund of 50% of the amount paid. Reservations cancelled within 14 days of arrival receive no refund unless the guest purchased travel insurance. Guests are required to complete a rental agreement by electronic signature within 3 days of booking. NOTE: The total reservation cost includes the nightly rate, clean fee, damage waiver, transportation fee (for select properties), processing fee and tax. By requesting a quote for this property, you agree to be added to our email subscription list.
